title: Trump says 'threat' led US to pull bombers from RAF Fairford
description: The Pentagon confirmed on Sunday it had removed the B1 bombers from the base in England back to their home stations in America.

title: Author and former politician Jeffrey Archer dies aged 86
description: Archer sold more than 300 million books in his five-decade writing career, and his last book, Adam and Eve, was due to be released later this month.

title: Rise in babies in care proceedings raises fears of unnecessary adoptions, experts tell BBC
description: With better support, many babies may not have needed to go into care, File on 4 Investigates is told.

title: MPs call for investigation after Lutnick-Epstein whistleblower dies
description: Simon Andriesz said he felt let down by the UK's Financial Conduct Authority before his death last month.

title: Europe is pouring billions into space. Can Glasgow's satellite industry keep up?
description: The city's space boom raises questions about the role of the state in backing important industries.

title: Man charged over Gosport migrant protest
description: Protesters held a demonstration after 149 migrants were brought to Gosport on Sunday.

title: Children brave snipers and mortars to go to school near Yemen front line
description: In rare access to Taiz, the BBC World Service speaks to children, teachers and families affected by the war.

title: UK oil refinery broke toxic pollution limits dozens of times, documents reveal
description: Pollution was spilled into local rivers and protected sites, documents shared with the BBC suggest.

title: I won't accept exclusion within Green Party, says Polanski after criticism of Zionism motion
description: Labour MPs and the European Greens have demanded clarity from the Green Party over a "Zionism is racism" motion.
